messages:
Ajay: FYI hit a P95/P99 tail on a 2k request. One safetensors shard stalled on read, ended up being ~720ms extra.

Kyle: Which loader path? warmup/prefetch/on-demand?

Ajay: On-demand. Warmup only fetched headers. Shard 5 still cold; fs read blocked then retried.

Dana: paste loader trace?

Ajay: ```
[weights-loader] open shard-0005.safetensors range=0-2097152
[net] GET /blobs/xyz range=0-2097152 -> 200
[weights-loader] mmap: ENOMEM for contiguous vaddr, fallback to read
[weights-loader] read 0-2097152 -> 5xx retry
[weights-loader] prefetch queued
```

Chris: mmap failures are still happening on large k8s pods due to address space fragmentation.

Maria: Suggestion: introduce 'staged-warmup' — 1) headers + tensor index always, 2) layered hot-range prefetch (first N bytes for each shard), 3) on-demand rest. Also a cheap local fallback: keep an fp16 packed copy in local cache and serve that if primary read exceeds X ms.

Kyle: API changes needed. WeightSource currently has get_blob(url) and mmap_hint. We should add read_range(url, start, end, priority) and async_prefetch(url, ranges[], token).

Dana: Also need worker-level prefetch quota + eviction LRU/working-set to avoid OOMs when many models are active.

Ajay: Tradeoffs: larger prefetch reduces subsequent latency but increases mem and egress. We can compute per-layer token-hotness from model metadata to rank shards for prefetch.

Chris: Manifest v2 idea: include per-shard 'hot_ranges' and per-range checksum and quantization fallback tags. That lets loader fetch exactly what it needs.

Maria: Long term: an index mapping logical tensor -> (shard, byte_range, quant_profile). Then loader can request only needed tensor bytes and decide fallback to quantized variant.

Dana: Runtime routing question: should smart-router switch to a variant in another region if a shard is cold and causing SLO violations? probably only for P99-critical tiers.

Kyle: agree, gated by policy and cost-accounting.

Ajay: Action items: 1) RFC for WeightSource API additions, 2) draft manifest v2 with hot_ranges and checksums, 3) prototype staged-warmup with per-worker budget. I'll simulate workload and attach numbers.

Chris: infra will test an mmap-friendly mount option short-term to reduce fragmentation.

Maria: I'll author the manifest sketch. Ajay add perf logs to RFC.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: staged-warmup-proto -> staging @ 2026-03-25T03:00Z :rocket:

Kyle: I'll start the API draft tomorrow, tagging eng-runtime in the PR.

Susan: :thumbsup: please loop security and eng-runtime for perf/security signoffs.
